source_notes.title: Forton Barracks - Wikipedia
source_notes.note: Infobox gives built 1807 and used 1807-1923; history notes Royal Marines left in August 1923 and the site recommissioned as HMS St Vincent in 1927 until 1969.

source_notes.title: HMNB Devonport - Wikipedia
source_notes.note: The naval barracks at Devonport were completed in 1889, named HMS Vivid, renamed HMS Drake on January 1, 1934, and remain in Ministry of Defence ownership as the Fleet Accommodation Centre.

source_notes.note: Lists the Devonport Navy barracks shore establishment as commissioned in 1890 and renamed HMS Drake in 1934.
